name: Workopia
description: Search, refine, and apply to live jobs sourced directly from company official career sites and ATSes across 94 countries and 44 languages. Tailor your resume to any specific job, draft a personalized cover letter, and follow up. Workopia turns a global job listing into a complete application, all without leaving Claude. Find roles by title, company, location, salary, remote work, or employment type.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Workopia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Workopia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://workopia.io/api/mcp-workopia. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Workopia MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Workopia provides these MCP tools: job_tool, job_detail_tool, tailor_resume_tool, and cover_letter_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Workopia?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Workopia in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
Workopia requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Workopia is developed by Heraai Pty LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
